## 建议行为 / Proposed behavior

<!-- 描述最小可用行为，以及它应如何呈现在 UI 或 API 中。
Describe the smallest useful behavior and how it should appear in the UI or API. -->

## 产品边界 / Product boundary

- 是否仍然坚持本地优先？ / Does this remain local-first?
- 是否新增服务商、外部服务、工具、插件或权限？ / Does it add a provider, external service, tool, plugin, or new permission?
- 是否需要新的模型权重、媒体或其他单独许可的资源？ / Does it require new model weights, media, or other separately licensed assets?

## 替代方案与权衡 / Alternatives and tradeoffs

<!-- 说明现有变通方案和重要风险。
Explain existing workarounds and important risks. -->

## 验收证据 / Acceptance evidence

<!-- 哪个测试、追踪记录或手动检查可以证明功能有效？
